title: Rama and others see the charming garden on Suvela mountain
introduction: Rama and the monkeys see the charming gardens and groves located in Lanka, viewing them from the top of Suvela mountain. Some of the monkeys, thrilling with rapture, enter the gardens and enjoy their beauty of flowers and birds. Some others went towards Lanka; located on the apex of Trikuta mountain. They see the city with its large mansions and seven storied buildings, including the thousand-pillared mansion of Ravana with a height almost touching the skies.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 39th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् रात्रिम् उषितास् तत्र सुवेले हरि पुम्गवाः |
लन्कायाम् ददृशुर् वीरा वनान्य् उपवनानि च
verses.iast:
tām rātrim uṣitās tatra suvele hari pumgavāḥ |
lankāyām dadṛśur vīrā vanāny upavanāni ca
verses.translation: The valiant army-chiefs of monkeys stayed on Suvela mountain for that night and saw the garden and groves in Lanka.

glosses.meaning: chief of the army of monkeys

verses.devanagari:
सम सौम्यानि रम्याणि विशालान्य् आयतानि च |
दृष्टि रम्याणि ते दृष्ट्वा बभूवुर् जात विस्मयाः
verses.iast:
sama saumyāni ramyāṇi viśālāny āyatāni ca |
dṛṣṭi ramyāṇi te dṛṣṭvā babhūvur jāta vismayāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing those gardens which were levelled, beautiful, spacious, majestic and enchanting to look at, they became astonished.

verses.devanagari:
चम्पक अशोक पुम्नाग साल ताल समाकुला |
तमाल वन संचन्ना नाग माला समावृता
हिन्तालैर् अर्जुनैर् नीपैः सप्त पर्णैश् च पुष्पितैः |
तिलकैः कर्णिकारैश् च पटालैश् च समन्ततः
शुशुभे पुष्पित अग्रैश् च लता परिगतैर् द्रुमैः |
लन्का बहु विधैर् दिव्यैर् यथा इन्द्रस्य अमरावती
विचित्र कुसुम उपेतै रक्त कोमल पल्लवैः |
शाद्वलैश् च तथा नीलैश् चित्राभिर् वन राजिभिः
verses.iast:
campaka aśoka pumnāga sāla tāla samākulā |
tamāla vana saṃcannā nāga mālā samāvṛtā
hintālair arjunair nīpaiḥ sapta parṇaiś ca puṣpitaiḥ |
tilakaiḥ karṇikāraiś ca paṭālaiś ca samantataḥ
śuśubhe puṣpita agraiś ca latā parigatair drumaiḥ |
lankā bahu vidhair divyair yathā indrasya amarāvatī
vicitra kusuma upetai rakta komala pallavaiḥ |
śādvalaiś ca tathā nīlaiś citrābhir vana rājibhiḥ
verses.translation: Thick with Champaka, Ashoka, Vakula Sala and palmyra trees, covered with groves of Tamala and Panasa trees, surrounded with rows of Nagakesara trees, Lanka looked splended on all sides like the city of Amaravati reigned by Indra the god of celestials, with green lawns and variegated avenues and with beautiful trees of various kinds like Hintala, Arjuna, Nipa Saptaparna in full flowering, Tilaka, Karnikara and Patal whose crests were laden with flowers and which were intertwined with climbers laden with multi-coloured flowers and red tender leaves.

glosses.meaning: covered with groves of Tamala and Panasa trees
surrounded with rows of Naga kesara trees laN^ka = Lanka
like the city of Amaravati indrasya = reigned by Indra the god of celestials
whose crests were laden with flowers
and which were intertwined with climbers
which were laden with multi-coloured flowers

verses.devanagari:
गन्ध आढ्यान्य् अभिरम्याणि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च |
धारयन्त्य् अगमास् तत्र भूषणानि इव मानवाः
verses.iast:
gandha āḍhyāny abhiramyāṇi puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca |
dhārayanty agamās tatra bhūṣaṇāni iva mānavāḥ
verses.translation: The trees there were laden with fragrant and greatly enchanting flowers and fruits, as human beings were laden with ornaments.

verses.devanagari:
तच् चैत्र रथ सम्काशम् मनोज्नम् नन्दन उपमम् |
वनम् सर्व ऋतुकम् रम्यम् शुशुभे षट्पद आयुतम्
verses.iast:
tac caitra ratha samkāśam manojnam nandana upamam |
vanam sarva ṛtukam ramyam śuśubhe ṣaṭpada āyutam
verses.translation: That garden, which bore flowers and fruits in relation to all seasons and with full of bees, like chaitraratha (garden of Kubera, the god of riches), was quite charming, like Nandana (garden of Indra the Lord of celestials)

glosses.meaning: which bore flowers and fruits in relation to all seasons
like chaitraratha (the garden of Kubera the god of riches)
resembling Nandana (the garden of Indra the Lord of celestials)

verses.devanagari:
नत्यूह कोयष्टि भकैर् नृत्यमानैश् च बर्हिभिः |
रुतम् पर भृतानाम् च शुश्रुवे वन निर्झरे
verses.iast:
natyūha koyaṣṭi bhakair nṛtyamānaiś ca barhibhiḥ |
rutam para bhṛtānām ca śuśruve vana nirjhare
verses.translation: In that garden abounding in cascades, the songs of birds like gallinules, lapwings(small white cranes), dancing peacocks and cuckoos were heard.

glosses.meaning: In that garden abounding in cascades
of gallinules and lapwings (small white cranes)

verses.devanagari:
नित्य मत्त विहम्गानि भ्रमर आचरितानि च |
कोकिल आकुल षण्डानि विहग अभिरुतानि च
भृन्ग राज अभिगीतानि भ्रमरैः सेवितानि च |
कोणालक विघुष्टानि सारस अभिरुतानि च
विविशुस् ते ततस् तानि वनान्य् उपवनानि च |
हृष्टाह् प्रमुदिता वीरा हरयः काम रूपिणः
verses.iast:
nitya matta vihamgāni bhramara ācaritāni ca |
kokila ākula ṣaṇḍāni vihaga abhirutāni ca
bhṛnga rāja abhigītāni bhramaraiḥ sevitāni ca |
koṇālaka vighuṣṭāni sārasa abhirutāni ca
viviśus te tatas tāni vanāny upavanāni ca |
hṛṣṭāh pramuditā vīrā harayaḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Then, those monkeys, thrilling with rapture, delighted, brave and assuming any shape at will, entered the aforesaid groves and gardens, with birds ever excited with joy, wandered by bees, with clusters of trees occupied by cuckoos, having variegated sounds of birds and song of the large bees, abounding with sounds of ospreys, with the music of wagtails and cries of canes.

glosses.meaning: and assuming any shape at will
with birds ever excited with joy
with clusters of trees occupied by Cuckoos
with singing by the large bees
with the musical sounds of wag tails

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् प्रविशताम् तत्र वानराणाम् महा ओजसाम् |
पुष्प संसर्ग सुरभिर् ववौ घ्राण सुखो अनिलः
verses.iast:
teṣām praviśatām tatra vānarāṇām mahā ojasām |
puṣpa saṃsarga surabhir vavau ghrāṇa sukho anilaḥ
verses.translation: While those mighty and splendid monkeys were entering the groves a breeze with flowery fragrance, delightful to the nose, blew.

glosses.meaning: sweet smelling due to contact with flowers

verses.devanagari:
अन्ये तु हरि वीराणाम् यूथान् निष्क्रम्य यूथपाः |
सुग्रीवेण अभ्यनुज्नाता लन्काम् जग्मुः पताकिनीम्
verses.iast:
anye tu hari vīrāṇām yūthān niṣkramya yūthapāḥ |
sugrīveṇa abhyanujnātā lankām jagmuḥ patākinīm
verses.translation: Some other troop-leaders of the valiant monkeys came out of their troops with due permission from sugreeva and went towards Lanka, the city adorned with flags

verses.devanagari:
वित्रासयन्तो विहगांस् त्रासयन्तो मृग द्विपान् |
कम्पयन्तश् च ताम् लन्काम् नादैः स्वैर् नदताम् वराः
verses.iast:
vitrāsayanto vihagāṃs trāsayanto mṛga dvipān |
kampayantaś ca tām lankām nādaiḥ svair nadatām varāḥ
verses.translation: Those monkeys, great in making noises causing the birds to frighten and displeasing to the animals and elephants, went, causing that Lanka to tremble, by their noises.

verses.devanagari:
कुर्वन्तस् ते महा वेगा महीम् चारण पीडिताम् |
अजश् च सहसा एव ऊर्ध्वम् जगाम चरण उद्धतम्
verses.iast:
kurvantas te mahā vegā mahīm cāraṇa pīḍitām |
ajaś ca sahasā eva ūrdhvam jagāma caraṇa uddhatam
verses.translation: Those monkeys with great speed marched ahead, making the earth flattened by their feet and the dust thus raised by their feet went up instant aneously.

verses.devanagari:
ऋक्षाः सिम्हा वराहाश् च महिषा वारणा मृगाः |
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता जग्मुर् भीता दिशो दश
verses.iast:
ṛkṣāḥ simhā varāhāś ca mahiṣā vāraṇā mṛgāḥ |
tena śabdena vitrastā jagmur bhītā diśo daśa
verses.translation: Frightened by that sound, bears lions buffaloes elephants, deers and birds were trembled and terrified and hastened towards ten different directions.

verses.devanagari:
शिखरम् तु त्रिकूटस्य प्रांशु च एकम् दिवि स्पृशम् |
समन्तात् पुष्प संचन्नम् महा रजत सम्निभम्
शत योजन विस्तीर्णम् विमलम् चारु दर्शनम् |
श्लक्ष्णम् श्रीमन् महच् चैव दुष्प्रापम् शकुनैर् अपि
मनसा अपि दुरारोहम् किम् पुनः कर्मणा जनैः |
verses.iast:
śikharam tu trikūṭasya prāṃśu ca ekam divi spṛśam |
samantāt puṣpa saṃcannam mahā rajata samnibham
śata yojana vistīrṇam vimalam cāru darśanam |
ślakṣṇam śrīman mahac caiva duṣprāpam śakunair api
manasā api durāroham kim punaḥ karmaṇā janaiḥ |
verses.translation: The solitary peak of Trikuta mountain, which is so high as if touching the sky, all over covered with flowers entirely, resembling gold; to an extent of eight hundred miles; bright; charming to look at, beautiful, glorious, majestic, inaccessible even by birds, hard to be ascended by people may, even by the mind-how much more by an act of walking?

glosses.meaning: to an extent of hundred yojanas(eight hundred miles)

verses.devanagari:
निविष्टा तत्र शिखरे लन्का रावण पालिता
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णा विंशद्योजनमायता |
verses.iast:
niviṣṭā tatra śikhare lankā rāvaṇa pālitā
daśayojanavistīrṇā viṃśadyojanamāyatā |
verses.translation: Lanka, ruled by Ravana, with a breadth of eighty mile and a length of one hundred sixty miles, was located on the apex of the mountain there.
notes: The length and breadth of the city given here varies from that given elsewhere - which is a hundred Yojanas wide and thirty yojanas long. This anomaly is reconciled by commentators by explaining the present verse as referring to the length and breadth of Lanka proper, which comprised the residence of Ravana.

glosses.meaning: with a breadth of ten yojanas (eight miles)
and a lenght of twenty yojanas (one hundred sixty miles)
on the apex of the mountain

verses.devanagari:
सा पुरी गोपुरैर् उच्चैः पाण्डुर अम्बुद सम्निभैः |
कान्चनेन च सालेन राजतेन च शोभिता
verses.iast:
sā purī gopurair uccaiḥ pāṇḍura ambuda samnibhaiḥ |
kāncanena ca sālena rājatena ca śobhitā
verses.translation: The city of Lanka looked beautiful with its towering City-gates resembling white clouds as well as with golden and silver ramparts.

verses.devanagari:
प्रासादैश् च विमानैश् च लन्का परम भूषिता |
घनैर् इव आतप अपाये मध्यमम् वैष्णवम् पदम्
verses.iast:
prāsādaiś ca vimānaiś ca lankā parama bhūṣitā |
ghanair iva ātapa apāye madhyamam vaiṣṇavam padam
verses.translation: The city of Lanka, greatly adorned by palaces and seven storied mansions, looked like the sky with clouds at the end of a summer and as a region of Vishnu (the god of preservation) between earth and heaven.

glosses.meaning: at the end of a summer
are to the region of Vishnu the god of preservation

verses.devanagari:
तस्याम् स्तम्भ सहस्रेण प्रासादः समलम्कृतः |
कैलास शिखर आकारो दृश्यते खम् इव उल्लिखन्
चैत्यः स राक्षस इन्द्रस्य बभूव पुर भूषणम् |
शतेन रक्षसाम् नित्यम् यः समग्रेण रक्ष्यते
verses.iast:
tasyām stambha sahasreṇa prāsādaḥ samalamkṛtaḥ |
kailāsa śikhara ākāro dṛśyate kham iva ullikhan
caityaḥ sa rākṣasa indrasya babhūva pura bhūṣaṇam |
śatena rakṣasām nityam yaḥ samagreṇa rakṣyate
verses.translation: A palace, duly graced with a thousand pillars, which looked like a peak of Mount Kailasa was three in the City of Lanka, which was always the City of Lanka, which was always protected by a complete army of demons. The palace seemed to be scraping the skies and was to be seen as an ornament to the City of Ravana.

glosses.meaning: which looked like a peak of Mount Kailasa
as an ornament of the city

verses.devanagari:
मनोज्ञाम् काञ्चनवतीम् सर्वतैरुपशोभिताम् |
नानाधातुविचित्रैश्च उद्यानैरुपशोभिताम्
नानाविहगसम्घष्टाम् नानामृगनिषेविताम् |
नानाकुसुमसंपन्नाम् नानाराक्षससेविताम्
ताम् समृद्धाम् समृद्ध अर्थो लक्ष्मीवाम्ल् लक्ष्मण अग्रजः |
रावणस्य पुरीम् रामो ददर्श सह वानरैः
verses.iast:
manojJṇām kāJṇcanavatīm sarvatairupaśobhitām |
nānādhātuvicitraiśca udyānairupaśobhitām
nānāvihagasamghaṣṭām nānāmṛganiṣevitām |
nānākusumasampannām nānārākśasasevitām
tām samṛddhām samṛddha artho lakṣmīvāml lakṣmaṇa agrajaḥ |
rāvaṇasya purīm rāmo dadarśa saha vānaraiḥ
verses.translation: The glorious Rama the elder brother of Lakshmana along with monkeys saw that charming golden city of Ravana, graced with mountains picturesque with various minerals, splendid with gardens reechoing with songs of birds of every kind, frequented by varieties of deer, richly endowed with various kinds of flowers, inhabited by demons of every degree and duly flourishing, having increased its wealth.

glosses.meaning: Rama the elder brother of Lakshmana
re-echoing with songs of birds of every kind
richly endowed with various kinds of flowers
inhabited by demons of every degree

verses.devanagari:
ताम् महागृहसम्बाधां दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः |
नगरीं त्रिदिवप्रख्यां विस्मयं प्राप वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
tām mahāgṛhasambādhāṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ |
nagarīṃ tridivaprakhyāṃ vismayaṃ prāpa vīryavān
verses.translation: Beholding that City, which looks like heaven and crammed with huge palaces, the valiant Rama the elder brother of Lakshmana was seized with astonishment.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् रत्न पूर्णाम् बहु सम्विधानाम् |
प्रासाद मालाभिर् अलम्कृताम् च |
पुरीम् महा यन्त्र कवाट मुख्याम् |
ददर्श रामो महता बलेन
verses.iast:
tām ratna pūrṇām bahu samvidhānām |
prāsāda mālābhir alamkṛtām ca |
purīm mahā yantra kavāṭa mukhyām |
dadarśa rāmo mahatā balena
verses.translation: Rama with his great army saw that City, full of precious gems, having all kinds of facilities, adorned with rows of mansions, having excellent doors with huge mechanical appliances and with a large armed forces protecting the City.

glosses.meaning: mukhyaam = having excellent doors with huge mechanical appliances
